type M = { [K in 0 | 1]: string };
type Key = keyof M;
const key: Key = 0;
const m: M = { 0: "zero", 1: "one" };
console.log(key, m[key]);
type C = { a?: number; b?: string };
type D = { [K in keyof C as "x"]: C[K] };
const d: D = {};
console.log(d);
type Same<T> = T extends unknown ? number : string;
const n: Same<any> = 1;
console.log(n);
